app.title: Cloud Climber
title.tagline: Bounce, steer, and climb past the stars.
title.controls: ← → / A D steer  ·  Hold mouse to steer  ·  Gamepad stick  ·  Esc pause
mode.daily_desc: Everyone climbs the very same tower today.
mode.endless_desc: A freshly shuffled tower for practice and records.
pause.title: Paused
settings.controls: Keyboard: ← → or A D · Mouse: hold and drag toward where you want to go · Gamepad: left stick or D-pad, Start to pause, Y to retry · Touch: hold the arrow buttons. The kitten bounces by itself.
results.hint: R / Enter / gamepad A: climb again
online.need_name: Enter a name to join the online leaderboard.
online.submitting: Sending your climb to the leaderboard…
online.preview_only: The online leaderboard wakes up in the saved preview or published game.
online.read_only: This is a read-only version; scores are not submitted.
online.too_low: Climb at least 1 m to get on the board.
online.daily_closed: That day's tower has closed. Try today's!
online.rate_limited: Too many tries — wait a moment.
online.unavailable: Leaderboard unreachable right now. Your best is saved on this device.
online.joined_next: Welcome! Your next climb will be ranked.
name.title: Name your kitten
name.desc: This name appears on the online leaderboard. Scores are sent automatically after each climb.
board.empty: No climbers yet — be the first!
share.title: Share card
share.ready: Ready! Save the image or copy the brag text.
share.saved: Image saved to the game folder.
share.text_daily: I climbed {m} m in today's Cloud Climber tower ({date})! Can you beat me?
share.text_endless: I climbed {m} m in Cloud Climber! Can you beat me?
tutorial.title: How to climb
tutorial.mouse: Mouse: hold and drag to steer
tutorial.goal: The kitten bounces on its own. Land on platforms and climb as high as you can — don't fall off the bottom!
hint.biscuit: Cracked biscuits crumble — don't count on them!
hint.cloud: Clouds hold you just once, then poof.
hint.moving: Winged planks drift side to side.
hint.spring: Land on a spring for a super bounce!
hint.enemy: Gloomlings! Stomp them from above, avoid their sides.
hint.rocket: Rocket: blast straight up, smashing Gloomlings.
hint.shield: Bubble shield: absorbs one Gloomling hit.
hint.magnet: Magnet: fish treats fly to you.
